about.heading: Opened in 2018, built around calm
about.intro: After twelve years in busy city centre salons, Megan wanted somewhere people could slow down.
story: Megan Wren opened Bloom & Wren in Chorlton in 2018, after twelve years working in city centre salons. She loved the craft but not the rush, and wanted a space where every client gets real time and attention.
Today the salon is a small team with a big following, especially among curly-haired clients who travel from across south Manchester for a cut that finally works with their hair.
Whether you're coming in for a trim, a full colour change or your wedding day, you'll be looked after by people who genuinely care how you feel when you leave.
